stories.title: Aitana, la princesa, regresa a Madrid

en.title: Aitana, the princess, returns to Madrid
en.summary: Singer Aitana, who shifted her public image three years ago toward edgier artistic expression, appears to be transitioning back toward a more polished persona while exploring her next creative direction.

stories.title: El ultra Farage recibe 42 millones de un empresario cripto, la mayor donación individual de la historia del Reino Unido

en.title: Ultra Farage receives 42 million from crypto entrepreneur, largest individual donation in UK history
en.summary: Crypto entrepreneur Ben Delo donated 42 million pounds to politician Nigel Farage, reigniting debate about legal limits on political donations in the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Lotería Nacional, hoy | Sorteo en directo del sábado 12 de septiembre: consultar resultados y premios

en.title: National Lottery, today | Live draw on Saturday, September 12: check results and prizes
en.summary: Spain's National Lottery held a drawing on Saturday, September 12, with the top prize valued at 600,000 euros per series.

stories.title: Lady Gaga, madre de su primer hijo

en.title: Lady Gaga, mother of her first child
en.summary: Lady Gaga and her fiancé Michael Polansky were seen in California with their newborn baby.

stories.title: La confianza en Trump se desploma en Venezuela mientras sube la de María Corina Machado

en.title: Trump's confidence plummets in Venezuela while María Corina Machado's rises
en.summary: A recent survey shows declining confidence in Donald Trump among Venezuelans following a petroleum agreement granting the United States control over 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves. Confidence in opposition figure María Corina Machado has increased during the same period.

stories.title: Cambio de hora en España 2025: este es el día que cambia al horario de invierno

en.title: Time change in Spain 2025: the day the clocks change to winter time
en.summary: Spain will transition from summer time to winter time during September as autumn begins. Spanish residents must adjust their clocks for this seasonal changeover that occurs regularly each year.

stories.title: La Policía investiga como un acto deliberado el descarrilamiento del tren que ha dejado 44 heridos en el norte de Francia

en.title: Police investigate train derailment that injured 44 people in northern France as deliberate act
en.summary: A railroad segment discovered on the track has led investigators to prioritize the theory that the train accident in northern France was intentionally caused. The derailment resulted in 44 injuries.

stories.title: Roban un cuadro de un Ecce Homo y un ángel del siglo XVII en dos iglesias de Valladolid

en.title: Painting of Ecce Homo and 17th-century angel stolen from two churches in Valladolid
en.summary: Two religious artworks were stolen from churches in Valladolid, Spain. An angel figure was taken from the altar of the Vera Cruz church, which houses significant works by renowned sculptor Gregorio Fernández.

stories.title: Muere Carles Solà, exrector de la UAB y conseller de Universitats en el primer tripartito

en.title: Carles Solà, former UAB rector and university minister in first tripartite government, dies
en.summary: Carles Solà, a prominent left-wing Valencian figure who served as rector of UAB and held university ministry, has passed away. He was instrumental in establishing the Vives University Network and the ACUP.

stories.title: «Hubo un chico en mi vida, pero no llegamos a formalizar nada»

en.title: "There was a boy in my life, but we never made it official"
en.summary: Marta González, a 29-year-old cloistered nun known on social media as sor Marta, shares her religious experience with followers and has gained media attention through her videos about convent life.

stories.title: Provisional 23 sale del hueco de la escalera

en.title: Provisional 23 leaves the stairwell space
en.summary: Provisional 23, an art project, relocated after two years in its original location within a rental property owned by promoter Pedro Huidobro, who pursued curatorial and artistic projects after experience in auction houses and art foundations.

stories.title: Lady Gaga ha sido madre de un bebé junto a su prometido, Michael Polansky

en.title: Lady Gaga has become a mother with her fiancé Michael Polansky
en.summary: Lady Gaga and fiancé Michael Polansky have welcomed a baby, photographed together in Northern California. The announcement surprised fans as it comes shortly after the singer completed her world tour in April.

stories.title: Scope eleva el rating de España a 'A+' y cambia la perspectiva a estable

en.title: Scope raises Spain's rating to 'A+' and changes outlook to stable
en.summary: Scope Ratings upgraded Spain's long-term debt rating from 'A' to 'A+' and shifted its outlook from positive to stable, citing strong economic growth, improved public finances, and reduced external vulnerabilities as supporting factors for the country's credit profile.

stories.title: Bancos: cómo subirse al tirón en Bolsa

en.title: Banks: how to ride the stock market wave
en.summary: Rising interest rates improve sector expectations despite valuations at record levels. Experts recommend selective investment after six consecutive years of gains in the stock market.

stories.title: Cómo armar la cartera de inversión tras la subida de tipos

en.title: How to build your investment portfolio after interest rate increases
en.summary: The European Central Bank raised rates to 2.50% and the Federal Reserve may increase its rates next week. Investors should adapt their portfolios to the new interest rate environment.

en.title: Where is oil heading?
en.summary: Escalating Middle East conflict with attacks on energy infrastructure increases supply disruption concerns, pushing oil prices higher despite weakening demand from elevated prices.

stories.title: VW, Toyota y Stellantis llevan a récord los ingresos del automóvil

en.title: VW, Toyota and Stellantis drive automotive revenue to record levels
en.summary: Inflation and sales of higher-equipped models boost major automakers' revenue to over 1.04 trillion, though profitability remains at minimum levels.
